name: 文字左欄＋右側直式圖片輪播
desc: 左欄放小標籤、大標題與說明文字，底部可放一組小插圖；右欄是一張略直式的圖片輪播，圖片上疊分頁點與圓形計數指示。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。左右兩欄，內容對齊頁面內容寬度：左欄約佔一半略少，放一段靠左對齊的文字，包含大標題（可多行）與說明文字，上方可放小標籤，沒有時省略；大標題明顯大於說明文字。右欄約佔一半，放一張略直式的圖片，圖片頂端略高於左欄文字。左欄的文字集中在上半部，左欄底部可放一組小插圖，底緣和圖片底緣對齊，約佔左欄寬度一半，沒有時省略。右側圖片是一次顯示一張的圖片輪播，可在多張圖片之間切換；圖片下方內側疊一組分頁點，右下角疊一個圓形計數指示，顯示目前是第幾張。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊，由上而下為小標籤、大標題、說明文字、小插圖（靠右），最後是圖片輪播；圖片對齊頁面內容寬度，維持略直式，分頁點與圓形計數指示仍疊在圖片下方內側。

en.name: Left text column + right portrait image slideshow
en.desc: The left column holds a label, a headline and a description, with an optional group of small illustrations at the bottom; the right column is a slightly portrait image slideshow with pagination dots and a circular counter overlaid on the image.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. It has two columns aligned to the page content width: the left column takes slightly less than half and holds a block of left-aligned text containing a headline (may wrap to multiple lines) and a description, optionally with a label above; omit it when there is no content. The headline is noticeably larger than the description. The right column takes about half and holds a single slightly portrait image whose top sits a little higher than the left column's text. The left column's text is concentrated in its upper half; optionally place a group of small illustrations at the bottom of the left column, its bottom edge aligned with the image's bottom edge and taking about half the left column's width; omit it when there is no content. The image on the right is an image slideshow showing one image at a time that switches between multiple images; a set of pagination dots is overlaid inside the bottom of the image, and a circular counter indicating the current image is overlaid in the bottom-right corner.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: Stack vertically, from top to bottom: label, headline, description, the small illustrations (aligned right), and finally the image slideshow; the image is aligned to the page content width and stays slightly portrait, with the pagination dots and circular counter still overlaid inside the bottom of the image.
